scoring_justification: Checker recomputes MARE of X_Sn_fcc against gold values obtained by solving the curvature-dependent equilibrium with the same pycalphad database and parameters.

outputs.description: Curvature-dependent equilibrium composition of Sn in the Pb-rich FCC matrix for the Pb-Sn binary alloy at 150 °C. The checker recomputes mean absolute relative error (MARE) of X_Sn_fcc against reference data, using hidden gold values.

output_contract.notes: Scoring is based on recomputed MARE against reference data; tolerances are hidden.
